requirements.requirement: Judge-verify CRITICAL 1 — development-checks 'A fresh install leaves the working tree clean' / scenario 'Install does not dirty the tree'
requirements.evidence: Reproduced in a `git archive HEAD` copy committed as a clean repo: `npm install` → ` M package-lock.json`, 3486 insertions / 3486 deletions, `git diff -w --stat` empty (whitespace only). Cause confirmed: committed lockfile is 2-space indented (line 2 begins with two spaces) while `package.json` is tab-indented since the format pass 74c8ae6; npm 11.19.0 writes the lockfile with `package.json`'s indent. `npm ci` leaves the tree clean (measured), so only `npm install` trips it. After regenerating the lockfile on the committed tree and committing, a further `npm install` leaves the tree clean (measured) and the lockfile is tab-indented. Task 1.7 ran the proof before the format pass changed `package.json`'s indent; no task re-ran it after 2.2. My implementation gate ran `npm ci`, not `npm install`, and so missed it.

findings.location: package-lock.json (committed at ef06173, 2-space indented) vs package.json (tab-indented since 74c8ae6); tasks.md 1.3/1.7/2.2 ordering; design.md Decision 5
findings.finding: One rule nobody wrote: npm writes `package-lock.json` with `package.json`'s indentation, so a lockfile generated before the format pass is rewritten by every later `npm install`. The development-checks requirement 'A fresh install leaves the working tree clean' is therefore unmet on HEAD (reproduced: ` M package-lock.json`, whitespace-only, 3486/3486). Task 1.7 proved the scenario on the pre-format tree, and the plan never re-proved it after 2.2, so the ticked record is true of the wrong tree. Nothing runtime breaks and `npm ci` is unaffected, so major, not blocking. Two routes, one cause: (Derek) regenerate the lockfile on the committed tree and commit it; (Bambadjan, plan gate) add the post-format clean-install proof to tasks.md and the one-sentence rule to Decision 5 so the record matches what was done and the trap cannot recur.
findings.required_change: Derek: on the committed tree run `npm install`, confirm `git diff -w --stat package-lock.json` is empty (whitespace only) and `git status --short` shows only ` M package-lock.json`, commit it alone as 'Regenerate the lockfile with package.json's indentation'; then prove the scenario — `npm install && git status --short` prints nothing — and `npm run check` exit 0; tick nothing new until Bambadjan's task exists. Bambadjan (through the readiness gate): tasks.md — add task 2.3 'Regenerate `package-lock.json` after the format pass: `npm install`, confirm the diff is whitespace-only (`git diff -w --stat package-lock.json` empty), commit it alone; Verified: `npm install && git status --short` prints nothing on the committed tree (development-checks "Install does not dirty the tree")', and move 1.7's clean-install sentence there, leaving 1.7 with the six-path commit check. design.md Decision 5 — append one sentence: 'npm writes the lockfile with `package.json`'s indentation, so the lockfile is regenerated after the format pass and the clean-install proof runs on the final committed tree.' No new mechanism, script or config value.
